title: Sundara Purushan
desc: A man loves his cousin, but circumstances force him to leave home. Years later, when he learns that she loves someone else, he tries to help her reunite with her lover.

title: Vana Yuddham
desc: Veerappan, a poacher, chooses the path of crime and becomes a dangerous criminal. He systematically kills all the policemen who try to stop his evil ways and nab him.

title: Mouna Geethangal
desc: A woman realises she is pregnant after she divorces her husband for having an affair. Many years later, her husband enters her life, eager to reunite with her.

title: Mahesh Babu No.1
desc: A rock star is convinced that his parents were murdered by three men. Taking the support of a journalist, he sets out to find the culprits.

title: Pottu Amman
desc: Driven by a thirst for power, a man kills 27 babies, each born under a unique star. However, to attain ultimate dominance, he must eliminate one final child born under an extraordinarily rare star.

title: Thambikku Intha Ooru
desc: Akil, a restaurateur from Singapore, is taken aback after learning that he has been adopted and sets out on a journey to Chengalpet in order to find his biological parents.

title: Ennai Paar Yogam Varum
desc: Jagadeeshwari's marriage gets called off and her father dies of the shock. She vows to take revenge upon Jaga, the man who caused the misfortune.

title: Ennavo Pudichirukku
desc: Santosh swears revenge on a woman named Sangeetha who slapped him after rejecting his advances. However, his quest for vengeance gets complicated when he learns that Sangeetha is his brother's lover.
